response.sql: SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, 1.0 * SUM(t.amount) / SUM(SUM(t.amount)) OVER () AS fraction_of_all_transaction_amounts FROM account AS a JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3 ORDER BY fraction_of_all_transaction_amounts DESC, a.account_id LIMIT 10;
